integrity: An analytical proof derives both constants and an absolute O(X^(1/4) log(2X)) error; exact integer enumeration through X=10^7 corroborates parametrizations but is not an infinite certificate. The literature comparison includes a partially available AMS chapter excerpt.
scientific_limitations: A hypotenuse-bounded asymptotic for primitive triangles with a perfect-square leg, not an assertion about all Pythagorean triples or a uniform theorem for other powers/heights. Earlier unindexed proofs or extensions cannot be ruled out.
title: Square legs in primitive Pythagorean triangles: an exact asymptotic and a two-to-one law
